speaker: alice
text: Let's kick off with something that always gets me, the humpbacks are cruising past the Sunshine Coast right now and spotters reckon the numbers this spring are some of the best they have seen in years. Whole families of whales, calves and all, putting on an absolute show for anyone with a decent set of binoculars.

speaker: charlie
text: Yeah I love this one, it is basically nature's own parade happening right off our coast. And up in the Bunya Mountains, local volunteers have just hit a huge milestone with their reforestation project, getting a heap of native trees back into the ground after years of hard slog.

speaker: alice
text: It is proof that when a community rolls up its sleeves, real change happens, tree by tree and whale by whale. Two lovely reminders that Queensland's wild side is doing just fine.
